creator_decision_summary: Keep the source window paused after changing the Task plan; execute current R3 in a new window after one minimal activation record.
The product is Web-only; native mobile and native desktop are outside scope and are not acceptance dependencies.
Use minimal Web + n8n + PostgreSQL stitching, with PostgreSQL owning transactions and truth.
Make one page the unit of frontend delivery: nine MVP pages have nine exclusive owner Tasks instead of fragmented feature Tasks.
Systematically inherit and audit prototype CSS, appearance, page layout, control hierarchy, interaction logic, visible states, and cross-page continuity.
Prototype functionality outside V7 anchors and acceptance remains a feature candidate and is not pulled into MVP by visual inheritance.
Use gpt-5.6-terra for Coder, Business Auditor, Reviewer, MVP Gate Runner, and any required Architect/Replanner; raise reasoning from medium to high based on registered Task risk.
Keep apps/api as optional thin security glue; the multi-agent deduction page containing FP008-02 is the only high-code exception.
Audit contracted interface business behavior and registered visual/interaction inheritance; add a Reviewer only for critical SQL, FP008-02, or control-contract changes.
Preserve FP005-01 scene_condition_package lineage, FP013-01 release order, and the post-MVP advanced observability candidate.
